headline: On last trading day, market closed for weekend; SEBI rules and corporate dividend announcements remain in focus.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 26 October.

why: The Indian stock market is closed on Sunday due to the weekend.
SEBI Chairman announced upcoming regulations to prevent broker terminal misuse.
Investors are tracking corporate actions including dividend-paying stocks for the week.
Markets await reopening on Monday following regulatory and corporate updates.
whatHappening: Fifteen companies including Chennai Petroleum, L&T Tech, Cyient, and Nippon Life AMC are in focus for dividends.
SEBI is introducing rules to prevent the misuse of broker terminals.
ISRO Chief V Narayanan clarified the role of private companies in space sector development.
Air India suspended flights to Riyadh and Dammam until November 7.
summary:
Markets remain closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 26 October.
SEBI announced upcoming rules to prevent broker terminal misuse, while dividend actions put 15 stocks in focus.
Investors are watching corporate updates from Chennai Petroleum, L&T Tech, Cyient, and Nippon Life AMC.
